examples.hanzi: 伤口还在流血，快去医院吧。
examples.pinyin: Shāngkǒu hái zài liúxuè, kuài qù yīyuàn ba.
examples.english: The wound is still bleeding; go to the hospital quickly.

examples.hanzi: 战争中，很多人流血牺牲。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng zhōng, hěn duō rén liúxuè xīshēng.
examples.english: In the war, many people shed blood and sacrificed themselves.

examples.hanzi: 感谢各位光临，欢迎下次再来。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnxiè gèwèi guānglín, huānyíng xià cì zài lái.
examples.english: Thank you all for coming; please visit again.

examples.hanzi: 今天有一位重要的客人光临我们公司。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu yí wèi zhòngyào de kèrén guānglín wǒmen gōngsī.
examples.english: An important guest is visiting our company today.

examples.hanzi: 这件衬衫太大了，我想换小一号。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chènshān tài dà le, wǒ xiǎng huàn xiǎo yí hào.
examples.english: This shirt is too big; I'd like to swap it for a smaller size.

examples.hanzi: 他每天上班都穿衬衫，打领带。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān shàngbān dōu chuān chènshān, dǎ lǐngdài.
examples.english: He wears a shirt and tie to work every day.

examples.hanzi: 那个金发的男孩是我弟弟。
examples.pinyin: Nàge jīnfà de nánhái shì wǒ dìdi.
examples.english: That blond boy is my younger brother.

examples.hanzi: 她把头发染成了金发。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ tóufa rǎn chéng le jīnfà.
examples.english: She dyed her hair blonde.

examples.hanzi: 这场大火摧毁了很多房子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà huǒ cuīhuǐ le hěn duō fángzi.
examples.english: This big fire destroyed many houses.

examples.hanzi: 一次失败不会摧毁他的信心。
examples.pinyin: Yí cì shībài bú huì cuīhuǐ tā de xìnxīn.
examples.english: A single failure won't destroy his confidence.

examples.hanzi: 她抱着孩子，胳膊都酸了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bào zhe háizi, gēbo dōu suān le.
examples.english: She held the child until her arms ached.

examples.hanzi: 他摔倒的时候，胳膊受伤了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuāidǎo de shíhou, gēbo shòushāng le.
examples.english: He hurt his arm when he fell.

examples.hanzi: 我们要学会尊重他人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào xuéhuì zūnzhòng tārén.
examples.english: We should learn to respect others.

examples.hanzi: 他总是愿意帮助他人。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì yuànyì bāngzhù tārén.
examples.english: He is always willing to help others.

examples.hanzi: 俄罗斯是世界上最大的国家。
examples.pinyin: Éluósī shì shìjiè shang zuì dà de guójiā.
examples.english: Russia is the largest country in the world.

examples.hanzi: 我想学俄罗斯语，去莫斯科看看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué Éluósī yǔ, qù Mòsīkē kànkan.
examples.english: I want to learn Russian and go see Moscow.

examples.hanzi: 哥们儿，借我点钱行吗？
examples.pinyin: Gēmenr, jiè wǒ diǎn qián xíng ma?
examples.english: Buddy, can you lend me some money?

examples.hanzi: 我和几个哥们儿周末去打篮球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jǐ ge gēmenr zhōumò qù dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: A few buddies and I are going to play basketball on the weekend.

examples.hanzi: 今天的天气异常闷热。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì yìcháng mēnrè.
examples.english: Today's weather is unusually hot and stuffy.

examples.hanzi: 医生发现他的检查结果有异常。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng fāxiàn tā de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ yǒu yìcháng.
examples.english: The doctor found something abnormal in his test results.

examples.hanzi: 这种疾病可以通过运动来预防。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jíbìng kěyǐ tōngguò yùndòng lái yùfáng.
examples.english: This disease can be prevented through exercise.

examples.hanzi: 老人常常受各种疾病的困扰。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén chángcháng shòu gèzhǒng jíbìng de kùnrǎo.
examples.english: Elderly people are often troubled by various illnesses.

examples.hanzi: 老师的职责是教书育人。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de zhízé shì jiāo shū yù rén.
examples.english: A teacher's duty is to teach and nurture.

examples.hanzi: 每个人都应该尽到自己的职责。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi jìn dào zìjǐ de zhízé.
examples.english: Everyone should fulfill their own responsibilities.

examples.hanzi: 心脏病是一种常见的老年病。
examples.pinyin: Xīnzàngbìng shì yì zhǒng chángjiàn de lǎoniánbìng.
examples.english: Heart disease is a common illness among the elderly.

examples.hanzi: 为了预防心脏病，你要少吃油腻的东西。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yùfáng xīnzàngbìng, nǐ yào shǎo chī yóunì de dōngxi.
examples.english: To prevent heart disease, you should eat less greasy food.

examples.hanzi: 公园是向公众开放的。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán shì xiàng gōngzhòng kāifàng de.
examples.english: The park is open to the public.

examples.hanzi: 这位明星很在意公众的看法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi míngxīng hěn zàiyì gōngzhòng de kànfǎ.
examples.english: This star cares a lot about public opinion.

examples.hanzi: 战士们在雪地里坚持了三天。
examples.pinyin: Zhànshìmen zài xuědì lǐ jiānchí le sān tiān.
examples.english: The soldiers held out in the snow for three days.

examples.hanzi: 他从小的梦想就是当一名战士。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng zhànshì.
examples.english: His dream since childhood has been to become a soldier.

examples.hanzi: 比赛中，她展现了出色的才能。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài zhōng, tā zhǎnxiàn le chūsè de cáinéng.
examples.english: In the competition, she showed outstanding talent.

examples.hanzi: 山顶上展现出一片美丽的风景。
examples.pinyin: Shāndǐng shang zhǎnxiàn chū yí piàn měilì de fēngjǐng.
examples.english: A beautiful landscape unfolded at the top of the mountain.

examples.hanzi: 你在楼下等我，我马上下来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài lóuxià děng wǒ, wǒ mǎshàng xiàlái.
examples.english: Wait for me downstairs; I'll come down right away.

examples.hanzi: 楼下的餐厅味道很好。
examples.pinyin: Lóuxià de cāntīng wèidao hěn hǎo.
examples.english: The restaurant downstairs tastes great.

examples.hanzi: 大量的游客涌进了这座小城。
examples.pinyin: Dàliàng de yóukè yǒng jìn le zhè zuò xiǎochéng.
examples.english: A large number of tourists poured into this small town.

examples.hanzi: 多喝水，身体需要大量的水分。
examples.pinyin: Duō hē shuǐ, shēntǐ xūyào dàliàng de shuǐfèn.
examples.english: Drink more water; your body needs a lot of fluids.

examples.hanzi: 我在门口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I'll wait for you at the entrance.

examples.hanzi: 学校门口有一家小书店。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào ménkǒu yǒu yì jiā xiǎo shūdiàn.
examples.english: There is a small bookstore at the school gate.

examples.hanzi: 他的证词帮助警察抓住了嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhèngcí bāngzhù jǐngchá zhuā zhù le xiányírén.
examples.english: His testimony helped the police catch the suspect.

examples.pinyin: Fǎguān rènwéi tā de zhèngcí bù kě xìn.
examples.english: The judge felt her testimony was not credible.

examples.hanzi: 请整理一下你的书桌。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zhěnglǐ yíxià nǐ de shūzhuō.
examples.english: Please tidy up your desk.

examples.hanzi: 我正在整理这次旅行的照片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài zhěnglǐ zhè cì lǚxíng de zhàopiàn.
examples.english: I'm sorting through the photos from this trip.

examples.hanzi: 我们周末去森林里露营。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò qù sēnlín lǐ lùyíng.
examples.english: We are going camping in the forest this weekend.

examples.hanzi: 森林对保护环境非常重要。
examples.pinyin: Sēnlín duì bǎohù huánjìng fēicháng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Forests are very important for protecting the environment.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影讲的是联邦调查局探员的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì Liánbāng Diàochájú tànyuán de gùshi.
examples.english: This movie is about the story of an agent of the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

examples.hanzi: 他在调查局工作了二十年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diàochájú gōngzuò le èrshí nián.
examples.english: He has worked at the bureau of investigation for twenty years.

examples.hanzi: 没有人可以强迫你做不想做的事。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qiǎngpò nǐ zuò bù xiǎng zuò de shì.
examples.english: Nobody can force you to do things you don't want to do.

examples.hanzi: 他是被强迫签字的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì bèi qiǎngpò qiānzì de.
examples.english: He was forced to sign.

examples.hanzi: 这件事注定会发生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zhùdìng huì fāshēng.
examples.english: This was bound to happen.

examples.hanzi: 他们注定要成为好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zhùdìng yào chéngwéi hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: They are destined to become good friends.

examples.hanzi: 他没有直接说，只是暗示我该走了。

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi le wǒmen yí ge xiǎo ànshì.
examples.english: The teacher gave us a little hint.

examples.english: There is a long scar on his arm.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì lǎobǎn zuì délì de shǒubì.
examples.english: He is the boss's most capable right-hand man.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào qiánwǎng Shànghǎi cānjiā huìyì.
examples.english: Tomorrow I will head to Shanghai for a meeting.

examples.english: Passengers are requested to proceed to gate three.

examples.pinyin: Xuésheng kěyǐ huòmiǎn bùfen fèiyòng.
examples.english: Students can be exempted from part of the fees.

examples.english: The person concerned does not agree to this method.

examples.pinyin: Lǜshī zhèngzài hé dāngshìrén jiànmiàn.
examples.english: The lawyer is meeting with his client.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān yǒukòng ma? Yìqǐ chī ge fàn ba.
examples.english: Are you free tomorrow? Let's have a meal together.

examples.pinyin: Děng wǒ yǒukòng, jiù qù kàn nǐ.
examples.english: When I have time, I'll come see you.

examples.english: This city has a population of two million.

examples.english: He won a million-yuan jackpot.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò lóutī hěn dǒu, xiǎoxīn diǎn.
examples.english: This staircase is steep, so be careful.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài lóutī shang yùdào le línjū.
examples.english: I ran into my neighbor on the stairs.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài shāngǔ lǐ dàshēng hūjiào, xīwàng yǒu rén néng tīngdào.

examples.english: If the other party doesn't answer, the system automatically calls the next number.

examples.hanzi: 大家都很同情这个受伤的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng zhège shòushāng de háizi.
examples.english: Everyone sympathized with the injured child.

examples.hanzi: 我不需要你的同情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xūyào nǐ de tóngqíng.
examples.english: I don't need your sympathy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme wénhuà bèijǐng?
examples.english: What is your cultural background?

examples.english: What time do you get off work? Let's go together.

examples.pinyin: Xiàbān hòu, tā xǐhuan qù jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: After work, he likes to go to the gym.

examples.english: I like fruit, for example apples and bananas.

examples.hanzi: 你可以做点运动，比如说跑步或者游泳。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò diǎn yùndòng, bǐrúshuō pǎobù huòzhě yóuyǒng.
examples.english: You could do some exercise, such as running or swimming.

examples.hanzi: 他对生活感到绝望。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì shēnghuó gǎndào juéwàng.
examples.english: He felt hopeless about life.

examples.hanzi: 别绝望，总会有办法的。
examples.pinyin: Bié juéwàng, zǒng huì yǒu bànfǎ de.
examples.english: Don't despair; there's always a way.

examples.hanzi: 她的法语说得非常流利。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Fǎyǔ shuō de fēicháng liúlì.
examples.english: She speaks French very fluently.

examples.hanzi: 我想明年开始学法语。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng míngnián kāishǐ xué Fǎyǔ.
examples.english: I want to start learning French next year.

examples.pinyin: Kuài jiào jiùhùchē, yǒu rén yūndǎo le!
examples.english: Call an ambulance quickly; someone has fainted!

examples.hanzi: 救护车很快就赶到了现场。
examples.pinyin: Jiùhùchē hěn kuài jiù gǎn dào le xiànchǎng.
examples.english: The ambulance arrived at the scene quickly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xīn fángzi lǐ, jiājù quán shì quánxīn de.
examples.english: The furniture in our new house is all brand new.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī dǎzào le yí ge quánxīn de pǐnpái.
examples.english: This company built an entirely new brand.

examples.pinyin: Tā céngjīng zài Xī Dé gōngzuò guo jǐ nián.
examples.english: He once worked in West Germany for a few years.

examples.hanzi: 那堵墙把西德和东德分开了很多年。
examples.pinyin: Nà dǔ qiáng bǎ Xī Dé hé Dōng Dé fēnkāi le hěn duō nián.
examples.english: That wall separated West and East Germany for many years.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān shuōshuo jīntiān fāshēng le shénme.
examples.english: First tell me what happened today.

examples.hanzi: 我们来说说下个月的计划吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen lái shuōshuo xià ge yuè de jìhuà ba.
examples.english: Let's talk about next month's plan.

examples.hanzi: 他输了比赛，心情很沮丧。
examples.pinyin: Tā shū le bǐsài, xīnqíng hěn jǔsàng.
examples.english: He lost the game and felt dejected.

examples.hanzi: 别沮丧，下次一定会更好。
examples.pinyin: Bié jǔsàng, xià cì yídìng huì gèng hǎo.
examples.english: Don't be discouraged; next time will be better.

examples.hanzi: 鹦鹉会模仿人说话。
examples.pinyin: Yīngwǔ huì mófǎng rén shuō huà.
examples.english: Parrots can imitate human speech.

examples.hanzi: 他很会模仿名人的声音。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn huì mófǎng míngrén de shēngyīn.
examples.english: He is good at imitating celebrities' voices.

examples.hanzi: 我姐姐在一家会计事务所工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zài yì jiā kuàijì shìwùsuǒ gōngzuò.
examples.english: My older sister works at an accounting firm.

examples.hanzi: 这家事务所专门处理房产问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shìwùsuǒ zhuānmén chǔlǐ fángchǎn wèntí.
examples.english: This firm specializes in real estate issues.

examples.hanzi: 这次地震是一场可怕的灾难。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn shì yì chǎng kěpà de zāinàn.
examples.english: This earthquake was a terrible disaster.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài zāinàn zhōng shīqù le jiāyuán.
examples.english: They lost their homes in the disaster.

examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái míngtiān yào cǎifǎng zhè wèi lǎorén.
examples.english: The TV station will interview this elderly man tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Jiēshòu cǎifǎng shí, tā xiǎnde hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: She looked nervous when being interviewed.

examples.hanzi: 大家对这家餐厅的评价很高。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā duì zhè jiā cāntīng de píngjià hěn gāo.
examples.english: Everyone rates this restaurant highly.

examples.hanzi: 你怎么评价这部电影？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme píngjià zhè bù diànyǐng?
examples.english: How do you evaluate this movie?
